breaking_changes: The /v1/models/{model}/options endpoint's resolved_ctx_size field can now return null instead of a numeric value when automatic GPU sizing cannot fit a valid context; clients must handle null gracefully.

checklist.author: @fl0rianr
checklist.text: Write a small HTTP client that calls /v1/models/{model}/options and verify it handles the null resolved_ctx_size without crashing, since existing clients may not expect a non-numeric value.

checklist.author: @sreeram-11
checklist.text: On a Windows machine with a Windows ROCm installation and an sd-cpp backend installed, start lemond with log_level=debug, load SD-Turbo with the rocm backend, and confirm the server log shows "Initializing backend: ROCm0" and the image generation completes in seconds rather than failing to the CPU.

checklist.author: @sawansri
checklist.text: Run `lemonade launch pi --api-key mykey` and verify that pi's process environment contains LEMONADE_API_KEY set to mykey, while pi's models.json contains "apiKey": "${LEMONADE_API_KEY}" rather than the plaintext key.

checklist.author: @jeremyfowers
checklist.text: On a 128 GB Strix Halo machine, start the server with a large model (e.g. gpt-oss-120b) using automatic context sizing and confirm the load succeeds and the model produces completions.

checklist.author: @jeremyfowers
checklist.text: Call GET /v1/models/<model-id>/options with a model that has automatic context sizing (ctx_size = -1) and confirm the response field resolved_ctx_size is a non-null integer.

checklist.author: @meghsat
checklist.text: Install a shared model family (e.g. Anima-aesthetic, Anima-base, Anima-turbo that share text encoder and VAE files), delete one variant, and confirm the shared text encoder and VAE files are also removed from the models cache directory.

checklist.author: @sreeram-11
checklist.text: On a Windows machine where LEMONADE_CACHE_DIR resolves to a path that, combined with the installed ROCm tree depth, exceeds 259 characters, start lemond and load any sd-cpp rocm model; confirm it fails with a ConfigurationException mentioning the cache directory length and that the error message suggests rocm_install_method=tarball.

checklist.author: @sreeram-11
checklist.text: Start lemond, load a model on the rocm backend, then attempt to load a second model with a deliberately invalid configuration; confirm the router throws the error immediately and the first loaded model remains active.

checklist.author: @sawansri
checklist.text: Run `lemonade launch pi --mcp --codemode` against a model and confirm the pi agent starts, pi's mcp.json contains a lemonade server entry with the correct URL, and pi's models.json includes contextWindow and maxTokens for the model.

checklist.author: @sawansri
checklist.text: Run `lemonade launch pi --model <a-vision-model>` and confirm pi's models.json sets "input": ["text", "image"] for that model, then verify the agent accepts an image paste.

checklist.author: @fl0rianr
checklist.text: Run the Lemonade server and load a model on a system with limited GPU memory (or simulate it) and confirm the /v1/models/{model}/options endpoint returns {"resolved_ctx_size": null} instead of a number.

checklist.author: @sawansri
checklist.text: Run `lemonade launch pi --no-mcp` when a lemonade entry already exists in mcp.json and confirm the entry is removed and pi starts.

checklist.author: @jeremyfowers
checklist.text: Open https://lemonade-server.ai/news/auto-bkc-vision.html in a browser and verify the hero animation cycles through all four agent/model/engine combinations (Hermes+Qwen3.8-Flash-Next+Halogen, Pi+Gemma 4+llama.cpp, AnythingLLM+Qwen3.6+FastFlowLM, DeepSeek Harness+DeepSeek-V4-Flash+DwarfStar4) and the status text updates correctly for each cycle.

checklist.author: @jeremyfowers
checklist.text: Resize the browser window to under 620px width and confirm the layout collapses: the hero animation stacks into a single column, the enabling technology table hides its header and stacks cells, and the flow-track columns stack vertically.

checklist.author: @jeremyfowers
checklist.text: Open the page in a browser with prefers-reduced-motion enabled (or use Firefox's responsive design mode with reduced motion) and verify all animations and transitions are disabled — the hero animation should show a static final state, and the enabling technology board should be immediately visible without the scroll-triggered fade-in.

checklist.author: @jeremyfowers
checklist.text: Verify the news feed at the Lemonade home page lists the new blog post with the correct title, date (October 20, 2026), description, and image.

evidence.blockers: Verify the Strix Halo regression fix works end-to-end on affected hardware (69948a7-1). Confirm the reverted API contract consistently returns integer (69948a7-2). Test the Windows ROCm backend path that was previously broken (1ba79d4-1).
evidence.breaking_changes: The resolved_ctx_size field temporarily gained nullable in 333469d but was reverted by 69948a7 to always return integer — the net shipping behavior matches v2026.43.3. Documented for client teams monitoring the intermediate change.
evidence.coverage: All 16 commits reviewed across the range v2026.43.3..69948a7. Coverage includes the model-delete regression fix (0100ec6), API contract change and revert (333469d + 69948a7), Windows ROCm re-enable (1ba79d4), pi launchpad flags (3614598), blog content (10166a8 + 05d32f0), and all CI/workflow changes.
evidence.manual_testing: End-to-end model load on 128 GB Strix Halo with auto-tuned context. Windows ROCm sd-cpp backend with image generation. `lemonade launch pi` flags against a real pi installation. API client null-handling for the (now-reverted) resolved_ctx_size edge case.
evidence.security: API key export to pi process environment verified off-disk (3614698-2). Windows ROCm DLL staging reviewed for hijacking mitigation. No new network calls or credential handling observed in this release.
